analyst_view.overall: Egnatia (26th of 36, 2 points) host Lincoln Red Imps (22nd, 3 points) in Tirana, still looking for a first win at this stage after two draws and a loss, with only two goals scored in three games; the club has sold cheap tickets and says it wants three points. Egnatia lead the Albanian league but lost 1-0 at Skënderbeu at the weekend; defender Bitri is suspended after two yellows and Bakayoko has a cruciate injury, both in the numbers, and several players left out of the European squad are already part of Egnatia's form. Egnatia rotate heavily (about 40% of the eleven kept over six games) with a league game on Sunday, while Lincoln report no absences and are more settled (about 65% kept). Swedish referee Oscar Johnson has no card record in the numbers. News today was thin and repeated the earlier picture, so nothing moves the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals and already add a little for Lincoln because Egnatia's regular defender Bitri is banned. Egnatia should attack at home in front of a bigger crowd, but their heavy rotation is already part of their recent form and Lincoln have a full squad, so I stay at 3.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners, 5.9 for Egnatia as the side expected to push, and they already count Lincoln's recent habit of conceding lots of corners and winning few. Nothing I found on lineups or tactics changes that picture, so I stay at 9.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards, split evenly, and already lift Egnatia a little for the cards Lincoln's opponents have collected lately. Referee Oscar Johnson has no card record in the numbers and I found nothing on his style; with no rivalry between the clubs I stay at 4.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.6 shots, two thirds of them for Egnatia, and already add about 10% for Egnatia because Lincoln have allowed many shots lately while cutting Lincoln for their own low shooting. Egnatia's rotation with a league game on Sunday is normal for them and already in their form, so I stay at 27.6.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target. Lincoln report a full squad and Egnatia's absences (Bitri, Bakayoko and the players left out of the European squad) are already counted or already in their form, so I stay at 9.4.
